title.zh: 信息熵 · 惊讶的平均值

description.zh: 越罕见的事发生时带来的信息越多（I = −log₂ p），把一个随机源每种结果的信息量按概率加权平均就是熵 H——它衡量这个源有多难预测，也是无损压缩平均每个符号至少要用的比特数。
description.en: The rarer an event, the more information its occurrence carries (I = −log₂ p); averaging that over a source’s outcomes, weighted by their probabilities, gives the entropy H — how unpredictable the source is, and the fewest bits per symbol any lossless compression can reach on average.

title.zh: 交叉熵与 KL 散度

description.zh: 真实世界按分布 p 出结果、模型却以为是 q 时，用 q 给 p 的数据标价得到的平均惊讶叫交叉熵；它比真熵多出的部分就是 KL 散度——模型错了要付的代价，也是机器学习分类损失的来历。
description.en: When the world produces outcomes by distribution p but a model believes q, the average surprise of pricing p’s data with q is the cross-entropy; its excess over the true entropy is the KL divergence — the cost of the wrong model, and the origin of the classification loss used in machine learning.

zh: 为什么分类模型用交叉熵

label.zh: 把概率换成惊讶再平均
label.en: Turn probabilities into surprise, then average

reason.zh: 熵是对每种结果的惊讶 −log₂ p 按其概率加权平均：分布越均匀越难猜、熵越大，几乎必然的分布熵接近 0。
reason.en: Entropy weights each outcome’s surprise −log₂ p by its probability: the more even the distribution, the harder it is to guess and the larger the entropy; a near-certain one has entropy near zero.

label.zh: 只有对数能让惊讶相加
label.en: Only a logarithm makes surprise add up

reason.zh: 两个独立事件同时发生的概率相乘，信息量却应该相加；能把乘法变成加法的是对数，所以信息量取 −log p，以 2 为底时单位是比特。
reason.en: The probability of two independent events multiplies, yet their information should add; a logarithm is what turns products into sums, so information is −log p, measured in bits with base 2.

label.zh: 信息增益就是熵的下降
label.en: Information gain is a drop in entropy

reason.zh: 决策树每一刀都选让子集平均熵下降最多的切法；这个下降量就是信息增益，用的正是同一个 H = −Σ p log₂ p。
reason.en: Each split in a decision tree picks the cut that lowers the subsets’ average entropy the most; that drop is the information gain, computed with the same H = −Σ p log₂ p.

label.en: True entropy is the floor of cross-entropy

reason.zh: 用正确的分布标价，平均惊讶就是熵 H(p)；换成错误的 q 只会更贵：H(p, q) = H(p) + KL(p‖q)，多出的 KL 永远不小于 0。
reason.en: Priced with the true distribution, the average surprise is the entropy H(p); a wrong q can only cost more: H(p, q) = H(p) + KL(p‖q), and the extra KL is never negative.

label.zh: 训练就是把交叉熵往下推

reason.zh: 分类模型把交叉熵当损失：它衡量模型分布 q 离数据分布 p 有多远，梯度下降沿它的下坡方向调整参数，让 q 越来越像 p。
reason.en: Classifiers use cross-entropy as their loss: it measures how far the model’s distribution q is from the data’s p, and gradient descent follows its downhill direction to make q resemble p.

question.zh: 一个文件最多能压缩到多小？
question.en: How small can a file possibly be compressed?

ask.zh: 为什么常见的符号该用短码、罕见的用长码？平均码长的下限是什么？
ask.en: Why should common symbols get short codes and rare ones long codes? What is the floor on the average length?

ask.zh: 符号出现的概率越不均匀，猜下一个符号是更容易还是更难？
ask.en: The more uneven the symbol probabilities, is the next symbol easier or harder to guess?

reveal.zh: 无损压缩平均每个符号至少要用 H = −Σ p log₂ p 个比特，哈夫曼编码能做到离这个下限不到 1 比特。符号越可预测，熵越低，能压得越小；完全随机的数据几乎压不动。
reveal.en: Lossless compression needs on average at least H = −Σ p log₂ p bits per symbol, and Huffman coding gets within 1 bit of that floor. The more predictable the symbols, the lower the entropy and the smaller the file; truly random data barely compresses at all.
